Buy Your NDT Course Bundle

Choose Level 1 or Level 2 — each bundle covers all five core methods: Radiographic Testing (RT), Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Magnetic Particle Testing (MT), Penetrant Testing (PT), and Visual Testing (VT). Checkout is handled securely by Stripe; you'll confirm your bundle level during checkout.

Level 1 Course Bundle

Entry-level training across all five core methods — the standard starting pathway for someone new to NDT. Self-paced online access via our eLearning portal, foundational theory for each method, aligned to SNT-TC-1A. Buy Level 1 Bundle

Level 2 Course Bundle

Advanced training across all five core methods, for candidates progressing from Level 1 or with prior field experience. Self-paced online access via our eLearning portal, advanced interpretation and defect-evaluation content, aligned to SNT-TC-1A. Buy Level 2 Bundle

What Happens After You Pay

Once your payment is confirmed, we automatically create your learner account using the email address from checkout and enroll you in all 5 methods for your chosen level. You'll receive an email with your login details and course access. Didn't get your access email? Contact info@atlantisndt.com with the email you used at checkout, and our team will set up your account manually.

Only Need One or Two Methods?

These bundles cover all 5 core methods together. If you'd like to select individual methods instead, contact info@atlantisndt.com or fill out our enquiry form and we'll put together the right combination for you.
